subject: Business Studies

internalBreakdown.component: Project: content, observation and research work

textbooks: Business Studies, Class XII, Part I and II (NCERT)
notes: The document gives marks for groups of units; each group is recorded as one unit carrying the group's marks.
One project from: elements of business environment, principles of management, stock exchange, marketing.

units.name: Nature and Significance of Management; Principles of Management; Business Environment

chapters.name: Nature and Significance of Management
topics: Management: concept, objectives and importance; effectiveness and efficiency
Management as science, art and profession
Levels of management
Management functions: planning, organising, staffing, directing and controlling
Coordination: concept, characteristics and importance
outcomes: Explain the concept, objectives and importance of management
Examine management as a science, art and profession
Understand the role of top, middle and lower management
Explain the importance of coordination

chapters.name: Principles of Management
topics: Principles of management: concept and significance
Fayol's principles of management
Taylor's scientific management: principles and techniques
outcomes: Discuss Fayol's principles
Explain the principles and techniques of scientific management
Compare the contributions of Fayol and Taylor

chapters.name: Business Environment
topics: Business environment: concept and importance
Dimensions: economic, social, technological, political and legal
Demonetisation: concept and features
outcomes: Describe the importance and dimensions of business environment
Understand the concept of demonetisation

chapters.name: Planning
topics: Planning: concept, importance and limitations
Planning process
Single use and standing plans: objectives, strategy, policy, procedure, method, rule, budget and programme
outcomes: Describe the importance, limitations and process of planning
Describe the types of plans

chapters.name: Organising
topics: Organising: concept and importance; organising process
Structure of organisation: functional and divisional
Formal and informal organisation
Delegation: concept, elements and importance
Decentralisation: concept and importance
outcomes: Explain the advantages, disadvantages and suitability of functional and divisional structures
Discuss formal and informal organisation
Describe the elements of delegation and differentiate delegation from decentralisation

chapters.name: Staffing
topics: Staffing: concept and importance; staffing as part of human resource management
Staffing process
Recruitment: sources, merits and demerits of internal and external sources
Selection process
Training and development: concept and importance; on the job and off the job methods; induction, vestibule, apprenticeship and internship training
outcomes: Describe the steps in staffing, recruitment and selection
Differentiate training and development and discuss methods of training

chapters.name: Directing
topics: Directing: concept, importance and elements
Motivation: concept, Maslow's hierarchy of needs, financial and non-financial incentives
Leadership: concept; authoritative, democratic and laissez faire styles
Communication: concept, formal and informal; barriers and how to overcome them
outcomes: Explain Maslow's hierarchy of needs and types of incentives
Describe leadership styles
Discuss barriers to communication and measures to overcome them

chapters.name: Controlling
topics: Controlling: concept and importance
Relationship between planning and controlling
Steps in the process of control
outcomes: Explain the importance and process of controlling and its relationship with planning

chapters.name: Financial Management
topics: Financial management: concept, role and objectives
Financial decisions: investment, financing and dividend; factors affecting
Financial planning: concept and importance
Capital structure: concept and factors affecting
Fixed and working capital: concept and factors affecting requirements
outcomes: Discuss the three financial decisions and the factors affecting them
Describe the factors determining capital structure and fixed and working capital requirements

chapters.name: Financial Markets
topics: Financial markets: concept; money market: concept
Capital market: primary and secondary
Stock exchange: functions and trading procedure; depository services and demat account
SEBI: objectives and functions
outcomes: Differentiate capital and money markets, and primary and secondary markets
Explain the functions of and trading procedure on a stock exchange
State the objectives and functions of SEBI

chapters.name: Marketing
topics: Marketing: concept, functions and philosophies
Marketing mix: concept and elements
Product: branding, labelling and packaging
Price: concept and factors determining price
Physical distribution: concept, components and channels of distribution
Promotion: advertising, personal selling, sales promotion and public relations
outcomes: Explain the features, functions and philosophies of marketing
Describe the elements of the marketing mix and promotion mix

chapters.name: Consumer Protection
topics: Consumer protection: concept and importance
Consumer Protection Act 2019: meaning of consumer, rights and responsibilities, who can file a complaint, redressal machinery, remedies
Consumer awareness: role of consumer organisations and NGOs
outcomes: Explain consumer rights and responsibilities under the Consumer Protection Act 2019
Discuss the redressal machinery and remedies available
Describe the role of consumer organisations and NGOs
